html:
If you are planning a trip from Hanoi to Mai Chau and return to Hanoi, Vietlook Travel offers a comfortable and flexible private car service with an experienced driver, allowing you to explore Mai Chau Valley at your own pace.

Mai Chau is a peaceful mountainous area in Hoa Binh Province, located approximately one hundred thirty to one hundred forty kilometers from Hanoi, with a travel time of around three to four hours each way, depending on traffic and road conditions.

About the Hanoi – Mai Chau – Hanoi Journey

The Hanoi to Mai Chau route is one of the most popular mountain trips in northern Vietnam. Many travelers choose buses, limousine services, or self driving to reach Mai Chau, often passing through Thung Khe Pass, which is famous for its scenic views of limestone mountains and valleys.

With a private car from Hanoi to Mai Chau, you can enjoy:

  • Flexible departure time from Hanoi

  • Comfortable travel through mountain roads

  • Photo stops at Thung Khe Pass and other scenic viewpoints

  • A relaxed journey without time pressure

Explore Mai Chau at Your Own Pace

Mai Chau is well known for its peaceful villages and rich ethnic culture. With our private car service, you are free to design your own itinerary, such as:

  • Visiting Lac Village and Poom Coong Village

  • Experiencing traditional Thai ethnic culture

  • Enjoying local specialties and traditional meals

  • Staying overnight at local homestays or high end resorts

  • Walking or cycling around the valley

Our driver will wait for you or follow your schedule during your stay in Mai Chau, depending on your travel plan.

Flexible Private Car Service for Return to Hanoi

After your stay in Mai Chau, our driver will transfer you back to Hanoi at your preferred time. The Mai Chau to Hanoi private car offers the same comfort and flexibility, allowing short stops for rest, coffee, or photos along the way.

This round trip private car service is suitable for one day trips, two day one night trips, or longer stays in Mai Chau.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced drivers familiar with mountain roads

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Assistance with luggage throughout the journey

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles to match different group sizes.
